g6.hypothesis: Unawaited command delivery plus unconditional sequence adoption pushes the client sequence backwards, after which later commands are dropped as replays and the run accepts nothing while looking alive.
g6.why_not_reproduced: Reproducing it requires the pre-fix adopt(), which assigned any incoming sequence unconditionally. Keeping that method alive only to fail a test would mean shipping the defect. A first attempt simulated it with local variables, which asserted nothing about this program, and was deleted rather than kept as a red test.
g6.what_is_tested_instead: The guard driven through the exact interleaving the hypothesis describes, plus the invariant that the run still accepts commands afterwards, plus the server-side invariant that an older command never lowers the stored sequence.
evidence: apps/mobile/test/reconciliation_test.dart::the G6 interleaving is refused rather than applied

silence_asset.why_bundled: just_audio's SilenceAudioSource is Android-only: AudioPlayer.java dispatches case "silence" to ExoPlayer's SilenceMediaSource while the darwin decodeAudioSource: has no silence branch and returns nil. Both platforms implement clipping over an asset URI, so silence is a clip of one bundled source.

android_bundle_size.threshold: the task set ~6 MiB as the point at which to report before optimising
android_bundle_size.verdict: well under; the simple WAV stands and no encoder or codec was added
android_bundle_size.measured_how: flutter build appbundle --release, as reported by the Flutter tool in the Android job of each run. Same tool, same job, both commits.
android_bundle_size.not_measured: The AAB's internal compression of the silence entry, and the installed APK size. The review's point that AAPT2 treats .wav as no-compress concerns the installed package; the AAB is a distribution format Play recompresses, so the 0.2 MB figure is an AAB delta and is not a claim about on-device footprint.

readiness.rule: Store release needs every axis PASS. NOT_RUN is the absence of a result and blocks exactly as a FAIL does. CI covers unit, HTTP, widget, platform-channel and real-SQL tiers, none of which is a device, a simulator, or a person listening.

budget.note: Reported against the SDD's forecast rather than rounded to it. The overage is threading and truthful fixtures, not new abstraction: no interface, base class or framework was introduced to satisfy a count.
